title: House subpanel approves proposed additional P2.349-B funding for DOTR, P132-M for DOJ
summary: The House of Representatives Budget Amendments and Review Subcommittee approved on Thursday, a proposed additional P2.349 billion for various programs and projects of the Department of Transportation.
